title: Conditional primary vanishing and finiteness across a dense open
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a reduced curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, $r$ a prime, and $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] with $r\,\mathrm{id}_F=0$. For any dense open $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ let $G=j_!j^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. In the original conditional convention of [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions], the assertion $C_3(X,F)$ is equivalent to $C_3(X,G)$, $C_4(X,F)$ is equivalent to $C_4(X,G)$, and $C_5(X,F)$ is equivalent to $C_5(X,G)$. Here $C_3$ is vanishing in degrees greater than one when the sheaf is primary for the positive characteristic [def-weil-pbc-primary-torsion], $C_4$ is finiteness of all cohomology under constructible invertible-order torsion, and $C_5$ is finiteness of all cohomology under properness and constructibility. The torsion predicates on $F$ and $G$ are not asserted to be equivalent.

source.place: Tag 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open), proof: the finite stalk product, five-term exact sequence, and remarks (a) and (b)

proof.text: Pullback and extension by zero are additive, so G is killed by r. Constructibility of G follows from constructible pullback and open-immersion extension by zero; finite type over k gives the required Noetherian and quasi-compact hypotheses.

For a primary prime p equal to r, both sheaves are primary and the counit bijection in degrees greater than one transports Subsingleton. When p differs from r, the sheaf satisfying the primary hypothesis is zero and its cohomology is zero.

If r is a unit in Γ(Spec k, top), both sheaves have invertible-order torsion. Apply the unconditional finite-cohomology equivalence to their conditional finiteness assertions. Otherwise each sheaf satisfying the invertible-order hypothesis is zero and has finite cohomology.
For proper finiteness, introduce the properness and constructibility instances and use the unconditional equivalence in each direction.

theorem dense_open_primary_finiteness (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] (hF : r • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let G := (U.ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
      ((U.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)
    (VanishingAboveOneOfIsPrimaryTorsionSheaf Λ F k ↔
      VanishingAboveOneOfIsPrimaryTorsionSheaf Λ G k) ∧
    (FiniteOfInvertibleOrder Λ F k ↔ FiniteOfInvertibleOrder Λ G k) ∧
    (FiniteOfIsProper Λ f F ↔ FiniteOfIsProper Λ f G)
